LanguageData.TPE_Settings_RandomMoods_Tooltip: Awake toddlers occasionally gain mood memories about small, everyday things.
LanguageData.TPE_Settings_RandomMoodMax_Help: How many random mood memories a toddler can have at once.
LanguageData.TPE_Settings_RandomMoodFrequency_Help: Hourly chance for each awake toddler to gain a random mood.
LanguageData.TPE_Settings_EventMoods_Tooltip: Toddlers react to raids, weather, deaths, weddings and other colony events.
LanguageData.TPE_Settings_SelfSoothing_Tooltip: Upset toddlers in cribs may try to calm themselves by sucking a thumb, clutching a blanket or thinking happy thoughts.
LanguageData.TPE_Settings_HeaterSnuggling_Tooltip: In cold weather, toddlers may seek indoor heaters for warmth and bring a plush toy.
LanguageData.TPE_Settings_GeothermalSnuggling_Tooltip: Also allow toddlers to warm themselves by geothermal generators and steam geysers. Off by default.
LanguageData.TPE_Settings_ConfinementPriority_Label: Increase crib escape priority with confinement
LanguageData.TPE_Settings_ConfinementPriority_Tooltip: Restless, frustrated and desperate crawling toddlers try harder to leave their crib. During a crying fit, escape priority returns to its normal value.
LanguageData.TPE_Settings_ChildCrying_Tooltip: Unhappy young children may cry, seek adult comfort and upset nearby people.
LanguageData.TPE_Settings_OlderChildCrying_Tooltip: Older children may also cry, for half as long and with half the mood penalty for nearby people. Applies only while the game still treats them as children. Off by default.
LanguageData.TPE_Settings_ParentIgnoreCryChance_Help: Each parent decides once per crying bout. Ignoring avoids the crying interruption; the child gets −5 mood for 12 hours. At 0%, parents always respond normally. At 100%, parents always ignore.
LanguageData.TPE_Settings_PrisonerCryAffectsColonists: Prisoner baby crying affects colonist mood
Prisoner babies, toddlers and children give nearby colonists the usual crying mood penalties, including their parents. On by default.
LanguageData.TPE_Settings_PrisonerCryAffectsOthers_La: Prisoner baby crying affects other people's mood
LanguageData.TPE_Settings_PrisonerCryAffectsOthers_To: Prisoner babies, toddlers and children give nearby non-colonists (such as prisoners, slaves and visitors) the usual crying mood penalties, including their parents. On by default.
LanguageData.TPE_Settings_ChildrenPlayNeed_Tooltip: Children gain a Play need alongside Learning. Play desires guide activities, and growth points depend on both needs.
LanguageData.TPE_Settings_AgeGatedDesires_Tooltip: Restrict each desire to its intended age group. Disable to let any child receive any play desire.
LanguageData.TPE_Settings_PlayDecayDays_Help: Time for a child's play need to drain from full to empty.
LanguageData.TPE_Settings_PlayGrowthWeight_Help: At 0, growth uses learning alone; at 1, play alone. At 0.5, both contribute equally.
LanguageData.TPE_Settings_ChildPlushSleep_Tooltip: Young children seek a plush toy before sleeping and gain the related comfort thoughts.
LanguageData.TPE_Settings_OlderChildPlushSleep_Toolti: Older children also seek a plush toy before sleeping. Independent of the younger-child setting.
LanguageData.TPE_Settings_MuteBabyCrying_Tooltip: Suppress crying audio. Tears and mood effects remain.
LanguageData.TPE_Settings_MuteChildCrying_Tooltip: Suppress crying and tantrum audio for all enabled child ages. Tears and mood effects remain.
LanguageData.TPE_Settings_BubbleLimit_Tooltip: Limit the number of bubbles rendered at once across the map, from 1 to 100.
LanguageData.TPE_Settings_BubbleOpacity_Tooltip: At 100%, use the texture's original opacity. Changes also affect bubbles already visible.
LanguageData.TPE_Settings_DebugLogging_Tooltip: Record diagnostic details for crib gates, heater snuggling and play activities. Off by default.
